press_references.value: Filigran Redefines Proactive Security: OpenBAS Rebrands to OpenAEV with an AI-Powered Enterprise Edition

product_launches.description: Filigran rebranded its OpenBAS platform to OpenAEV and launched OpenAEV Enterprise Edition, adding AI-assisted scenario generation, risk‑based remediation guidance, EDR‑agent validation, SaaS hosting, and support for large security teams.

overview_description.description: Filigran offers a suite of open-source cybersecurity tools under its eXtended Threat Management (XTM) portfolio, focused on threat intelligence, breach and attack simulation, and cyber risk oversight. It provides OpenCTI, a platform for organizing and operationalizing cyber threat intelligence, and OpenBAS, a system for simulating attack scenarios and validating security posture. Filigran supports flexible deployment models including open-source self-hosted versions and fully managed SaaS instances. The company also provides support, training, and integration services, and collaborates with technology partners and security providers to ensure interoperability.

about_short_description.short_description: Filigran provides an open-source cybersecurity solutions including threat intelligence management and cyber risk management.

product.name: XTM Platform
product.description: An open-source extended threat management platform that unifies cyber threat intelligence, security validation, and remediation workflows for threat-informed defense.

product.name: OpenCTI
product.description: An open-source cyber threat intelligence platform for structuring, enriching, investigating, sharing, and operationalizing threat intelligence.

product.name: OpenAEV
product.description: An open-source adversarial exposure validation platform for creating attack simulations, testing security controls, and measuring security readiness.

product.name: XTM One
product.description: An AI-native orchestration and automation layer for coordinating threat intelligence and security validation workflows across Filigran’s threat management environment.

product.name: XTM Hub
product.description: A community-driven portal for accessing Filigran documentation, integrations, demonstrations, pre-built content, product resources, and subscribed services.

product.name: Software as a Service
product.description: Hosted delivery of Filigran cybersecurity software, providing managed access to its threat intelligence and security validation capabilities.
